statement: Tr MP+Nunchuk with external-style inactive ID option on passes native Dolphin bounded decoded gyro and Nunchuk stick with re-attach and both shims on. Mode 05, report-mode resend, F6 and both imported calibration blocks succeed. Independent dense owned-window samples qualify stick change; raw frames are not the decoded oracle. Both ID styles pass, so the external-style option is not shown necessary for this consumer. No physical/radio/game/release/timing or whole-controller qualification.

applicability.revision: Tr / virtual Wii Remote Plus PID 0330; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. W9h controlled local virtual-host experiment, synthetic imported calibration and explicit binding/creation flags. Independent decoded oracle is separate from raw frames; no physical/radio/game/release/timing or whole-controller qualification. #258 gates generic-binding release use.
